title: Cathie Wood says ARK’s Bitcoin $1.5M bull price hasn’t changed as markets eye rally
summary: ARK Invest expects another $300 billion in liquidity to return after the government shutdown, a development that may alleviate the “liquidity squeeze” affecting crypto and AI valuations.

title: Upbit hit with $36M Solana hot wallet breach day after $10B Naver deal
summary: The breach occurred as Upbit’s parent company, Dunamu, sealed a $10 billion acquisition deal with Naver and plans an initial public offering in the US.

title: Abu Dhabi regulator approves Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin for institutional use
summary: Ripple’s dollar-backed stablecoin secures a major regulatory win as Abu Dhabi allows licensed firms to use RLUSD inside its international financial center.

title: Buterin donates to 2 projects pushing ‘next steps’ of digital privacy
summary: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin has just donated over $760,000 in Ether to two projects he says are pushing digital privacy forward.

title: Australia moves forward with bill to regulate crypto under finance laws
summary: Australia has taken another step to introduce legislation that will subject crypto platforms to the same laws and licensing obligations as financial institutions.

title: XRP ETFs absorb 80M tokens: Is a new bull trend starting for the altcoin?
summary: Two new XRP ETFs absorbed 80 million tokens on launch as the price formed a bullish flag after hitting resistance at $2.20.

title: This indicator suggests we’re out of the Bitcoin bull market
summary: Bitcoin's 200-day trend has turned bearish, which could suggest the bull market is over, but some analysts don’t think we’re there yet.

title: Bearish Bitcoin mining data may be counter signal that encourages spot-driven BTC rally
summary: Bitcoin’s miner margins and NVT metric indicated a bottom range, but a final downside sweep remains possible.

title: Animoca bets on altcoin upside to lure investors as it plans for IPO
summary: Animoca Brands’ founder, Yat Siu, anticipates that the crypto industry will not have a one-winner “takes all” scenario like the internet era in the early 2000s.

title: SEC tokenized stock exemptions should be targeted, stock exchanges argue
summary: A group representing major stock exchanges has urged the SEC to abandon its plan to grant an “innovation exemption” to brokers and crypto firms seeking to offer tokenized stocks.
